description: Op-shaped job that deletes old AssetCheckResult events from the event log. Filters by max_age_days and optional per-asset scoping.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.description: Cron schedule; default weekly Sunday at 5am.

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Empty = all assets; list to scope.

max_age_days.label: Max Age Days
max_age_days.description: Delete check results older than this many days.

max_deletes_per_run.label: Max Deletes Per Run
max_deletes_per_run.description: Hard cap on events deleted per tick.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If True (default), log what WOULD be deleted without deleting.
